definitions.explanation: A very young child, typically under one year old.

⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{先月|せんげつ}→先月：00751_sengetsu⟧{赤|あか}ん{坊|ぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{産|う}んで→産む：01899_umu⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{世話|せわ}→世話：02088_sewa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
{赤|あか}ん{坊|ぼう} refers specifically to a baby or infant, typically under one year old.

ETYMOLOGY:
From ⟦{赤|あか}→赤：02842_aka⟧ (red) + {坊|ぼう} (boy/child), referring to the reddish skin color of newborns.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {赤|あか}ん{坊|ぼう}: baby, infant (neutral)
- ⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧: baby (affectionate, more common in speech)
- ⟦{乳児|にゅうじ}→乳児：11414_nyuuji⟧: infant (formal/medical)
- ⟦{幼児|ようじ}→幼児：12478_youji⟧: toddler, young child (1-6 years)
- {新生児|しんせいじ}: newborn (medical term)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {赤|あか}ん{坊|ぼう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{泣|な}く→泣く：00655_naku⟧: baby cries
- {赤|あか}ん{坊|ぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抱|だ}く→抱く：02131_daku⟧: to hold a baby
- {赤|あか}ん{坊|ぼう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{世話|せわ}→世話：02088_sewa⟧: baby care
- {赤|あか}ん{坊|ぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{寝|ね}かせる→寝かせる：12322_nekaseru⟧: to put a baby to sleep

USAGE:
⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧ is more commonly used in everyday conversation, while {赤|あか}ん{坊|ぼう} sounds slightly more formal or literary.
